cases.name: Shelia Ann Kelly
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She loved to be outdoors, and was very adventurous. She enjoyed, riding bikes, hunting, and fishing. She also loved the company of her dog, Beau, which brought her true joy."
cases.narrative: On 2/17/2023, her body was found during a welfare check.
